card.name: Sky Rush
card.description: Race as birds down colorful slopes, build speed by sliding smoothly, and compete for best times with friends across diverse worlds like Mushroom, Grass, and Ice. Fun, fast-paced, and all about improving your record.

card.name: Bird Poo Game
card.description: Cause chaos from the sky and profit underground. Drop poop on pedestrians to send them rushing to Bob's laundromat. Collect coins, upgrade machines, unlock explosive abilities, and build a bizarre laundry empire one splat at a time.

card.name: Radioactivity
card.description: Radioactivity is a co-op survival horror. You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, help your state clean up post-apocalyptic radioactive wilderness. Plan each deployment, fight radiation spread and the creatures that it produces. Together, make WEA flourish once more!

card.name: Dream Village
card.description: Immerse yourself in the cozy world of village life! Set up your home, buy groceries or order home delivery, cook delicious soups, manage your farm and earn real estate. Dream Village - dreams become reality!

card.name: Maum
card.description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Collect potions and spells, use them wisely against enemies for protection or fun.

card.name: Drunken Cowboys
card.description: Perforate, blow up, and take down friends and foes in tight, dusty Wild West arenas - all after you’ve all had a solid drink at the saloon. Drink, reload, shoot, drink again, and repeat. A stylish hat is guaranteed, so you can leave yours at home.

card.name: Clean Memories
card.description: Clean, repair, and organize forgotten spaces. Uncover the memories hidden beneath the dirt in this relaxing first-person cleaning adventure.

card.name: Pumpkin Is Yummy!?
card.description: Your own little farm village, tucked into the corner of your desktop. Raise a chatty pumpkin, tend your crops, and collect critters in this quirky, lighthearted idler. How you raise your Pumpkin decides who they become.

card.name: DETRUST
card.description: DETRUST is an online co-op game for up to 12 players, built on teamwork and betrayal. You’ve been sent to repair a damaged facility before the scheduled decontamination begins. Complete tasks, stay alert, and try to escape alive… before one of you tries to kill the entire crew.

card.name: Silver Lake National Park
card.description: Welcome to Silver Lake National Park, where Ranger Logan keeps the trails clear, the campfires warm, and the supernatural community hidden in plain sight. He's a werebear who learned long ago not to fight what he is. These days he makes sure everyone feels at home, even when he can't always feel it.

card.name: Pakku Pony
card.description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

card.name: Captain Speedfin
card.description: Captain Speedfin is stuck with an hourglass and needs to be fast! Race against the clock through 60 challenging levels of pirate parkour, where every second counts. Grab your treasure and get out before time runs out!

card.name: Wander Her Way VR
card.description: Explore incredible interactive locations with your gorgeous companion. A sandbox VR experience with mini-games. Shoot enemies, destroy objects, drive a car, dance with an amazing girl, defend a tower, catch mischievous kittens, watch a fireworks show. Realistic female character, advanced physics

card.name: Snakez Arena
card.description: Snakez Arena is a 2.5D platformer shooter with it's unique movement, projectile characteristics and includes multiple game modes! Download now to try out the bulllet hell!

card.name: Joaquin Simulator
card.description: Help retiree Joaquin on his road trip through Brazil. It's a 2000 km journey full of challenges, and nothing is simple in Brazil. You must eat, drink, smoke, earn money, deal with corrupt cops, all to reach a party to save democracy in Brazil.

card.name: Coasteroid
card.description: Build stellar rollercoasters across alien worlds, carve tunnels through planets, and launch trains into orbit. Customize every track element, scenery decoration, and environment before subjecting riders to the forces of the universe! The galaxy is your theme park!

card.name: Master of the Mow
card.description: Become the Master of the Mow. Cut grass, clear trash, and uncover buried treasures across the overgrown grounds of an old manor estate. Upgrade your tools and grow stronger with each trinket you sell and solve the mystery of why the grass grows back every morning. Can you finish it all in one day?

card.name: GUNtai
card.description: Craft your gun. Shoot down enemies hordes. Upgrade weapon, remake weapon, combine weapon. Unlock new characters and new modules. Make great gunsmiths regret their inventions!

card.name: Mech Assembler: Model Kit builder Simulator
card.description: Welcome to Mech Assembler, a relaxing puzzle game inspired by model kit (Gunpla) construction. You'll experience the relaxing process of building a model. Once assembled, you can paint it with Spry. Earn points based on your accuracy and unlock new elements.

card.name: Burger Rush Simulator
card.description: Burger Rush Simulator is a fast food simulator where you manage your fast food restaurant, order supplies, restock containers, take payments at checkout and drive-thru, prepare meals, hire staff, expand your kitchen and dining area, and unlock features like storage and touchscreen checkout.

card.name: Dreamcraft: Lumberjack
card.description: Chop the sick trees to purify the forests. Gather lumber, upgrade your axe, and improve stats. No rush, no stress, relax in cozy and beautiful lands, rescue animals, and unravel the secrets of the wilderness. Nature must be preserved so cut the shadow and restore the light!

card.name: DigSite: Archeology in Egypt
card.description: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

card.name: Pinewater
card.description: Pinewater is a cozy first-person fishing game about restoring a run-down lakeside cabin. Catch rare and legendary fish, restore and decorate your lakeside home, plant trees, and shape the surroundings to your liking — all at your own pace.

card.name: Marble Run Maker
card.description: Build marble runs in a room with realistic physics. Stack random objects to make a wobbly track and watch the ball roll down! Explore puzzles with unlimited solutions.

card.name: Tiny Tree Talk
card.description: Grow and shape bonsai trees, build tiny dioramas, and find a new sense of belonging on TinyTreeTalk - a wholesome bonsai internet forum. Enjoy full sandbox freedom or bring requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props, and enjoy chill lofi beats and a nostalgic mid-2000s Japan.

card.name: Sweep City
card.description: Keep your streets clean and discover hidden treasures in this relaxing street sweeper adventure. Drive through procedurally generated neighborhoods, uncover rare finds, and upgrade your sweeper with unique specializations. Cruise to your own tunes while keeping the city spotless.

card.name: CHARK
card.description: Chess and deckbuilding collide in a compact 5×5 roguelike battlefield of risk and reward. Build momentum from a lone King: stack small advantages, gamble on bold moves, and watch the rules bend as your King snowballs to victory. Short, intense runs how far can you go?

card.name: Kaiju Catastrophe
card.description: Crush, smash, and eat thousands of enemies showing humanity what the meaning of destruction is! Kaiju Catastrophe is an arcade game with roguelite mechanics. Mutate devastating weapons, unlock permanent evolutions, and wreak havoc with a variety of monsters to tear humanity apart!

card.name: Let's Drive - learn driving simulator
card.description: There are 1.3 billion cars in the world. But how many good drivers are there? Is every one of them trained and competent? Find out while playing Let's Drive, a driving school simulator that shows you hazardous situations on the road and puts you right in them.

card.name: Motorsport Park Manager
card.description: Build and customize your own motorsports park in this classic tycoon simulation. Start with local go-kart tracks and grassroots circuits, and grow into a world-renowned racing destination.

card.name: Plate And Profit
card.description: Can you make rent with a spicy bowl of lettuce and ketchup? Run a chaotic kitchen in this Cooking Roguelite! Manage ingredients, build your synergies and strategies with spices and decor, and serve customers before their patience runs out.

card.name: Red & Blue
card.description: Play as two housecats causing chaos while their owners are gone! Jump on each other, get chained to each other, and help each other solve color-coded puzzles.

card.name: Deep Hunger
card.description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

card.name: One Wrong Step
card.description: One wrong move can change everything... Explore trapped rooms in this tactical roguelite inspired by Minesweeper. Every square is a risk. Every exit, a choice. Think carefully... or start again.

card.name: Purrfect Collars
card.description: Purrfect Collars is a cozy single-player shopkeeping adventure. As a witch, design collars, enchant them with potions, manage your shop and meet interesting new customers! Each collar holds meaning, every cat a story!

card.name: Meal Quest
card.description: Explore the magical world inside your fridge, plan meals, and fight your way to the Dream City. Your in-game nutrition choices grant you combat bonuses that reflect each vitamin’s actual role in the body.

card.name: Drawing Dead
card.description: Drawing Dead is a roguelike deckbuilder with an occult personality. Swap cards on a 5×5 grid to form hands, bind legions of demons with game-changing powers, and enchant your deck into an infernal scoring engine.

card.name: Burakku Jakku Samurai
card.description: A tactical pixel-art roguelite. Manage your Ki up to a lethal limit of 21. Bend the rules of the duel with special cards to alter combat conditions. Risk it all to hit exactly 21 for a Perfect Focus lethal strike. Plan your route and survive. Your strategy is your sharpest weapon.

card.name: Gold Rush
card.description: Stake your claim on the frontier in this fast-paced Wild West RTS.

card.name: SlopTuber Simulator
card.description: SlopTuber Simulator is a short incremental adventure about filling the internet with worthless video content for fun and profit (Mostly for profit)!

card.name: DIGI-DOLL
card.description: Mauve takes on the job of a decorator. Design and decorate dollhouses for different ragdolls and appease their unique tastes. Use the retro DIGI-DOLL console to explore the attic, unlock various dollhouses, befriend characters, and discover stunning furnishings to fill them with.

card.name: The Haunting of the Chea-Wilson Family
card.description: A Cambodian-American family becomes haunted by a ghost. Enjoy this story-driven narrative as the haunting unfolds. Inspired by horror movies in the late 2000s-2010s.

card.name: Hell Loop
card.description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler with Chinese mythic horror. Play as an ancient butcher, trapped in the cycles of the underworld. Seek redemption, gain the aid of heavenly gods, and fight for freedom—and for the wife you still love.

card.name: Goop Up!
card.description: A vibrant and mysterious world filled with enchanted hats, oozing clumps of slime, hidden pathways, and a terrible king. Follow the trail of adventure to defeat the king and save the world from his tyrannical rule!

card.name: Yuki-Tundra
card.description: Build your store empire, help the local community and keep the shelves stocked in a bid to boost your stores reputation while you rise from the ashes. Yuki-Tundra blends the casual store management genre with classic RPG adventures.

card.name: Heretic Red
card.description: In this story-rich detective game, uncover clues through a card-like system to solve a series of bizarre murders. Combine pieces of evidence to build your case against the most likely culprit from within an eclectic cast of unusual characters.

card.name: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher's Life
card.description: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher’s Life is a top-down story adventure game about an unusual research life between a sloppy senior student and a helpful junior.

card.name: Kkokko Industry
card.description: Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you manage a chicken farm. The game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.

card.name: Birdoo
card.description: Birdoo: Feathered Fury is an indie action game were you assume the role of a bird embarking on a quest for revenge against the humans who wronged him. No longer will you tolerate being called a "flying rat" or being shooed away. It's time to exact your revenge!

card.name: SketchBrawl
card.description: Sketchbrawl is an auto-battler: draft squads from six factions, deploy them on the grid, and watch hundreds of units clash on their own. Promote squads to ★★★, let your commander’s skill turn the tide, and survive ten rounds to clear the Arena.

card.name: QiuQiu Town
card.description: You have come to this new world, where you will start a new life, have many options, run the farm, scale up, and become a great agriculturist. Or run a store and become a business mogul. Or ordinary life every day, if you were given the chance to do it again, what would you choose?

card.name: Hand Shadow
card.description: Challenge your mind with puzzles that are based on optical illusions. Find the perfect position and angle by rotating the hands until order is restored, and discover a story of protagonist Morgan with professional voicing.

card.name: Crimson Crisis
card.description: A fast-paced action roguelike where skill beats firepower. Outmaneuver swarms, harness Poison/Inflame/Traumatize, and expand the game with mods & co-op.

card.name: Aircraft Dispatcher: Ground Operations
card.description: Take charge of airport operations. Manage aircraft maintenance, ground support, equipment, and taxiway movements, then leave the office to inspect aircraft, investigate damage, clear FOD, respond to emergencies, and keep flights moving safely and on schedule.

card.name: Fizz Flow: Factory Management
card.description: Fizz Flow is a strategy and management game that takes place in a setting without competition regulations. In old America, where the beverage industry is on the rise, build your own factory, make your own unique recipes, weaken your opponents and maintain your hard earned success at the market!

card.name: Bite the Crown
card.description: In a world ruled by sugary tyrants, an unlikely hero rises from the shadows: Pom the Mold. Build your secret guild, gather rogue treats, lead the rebellion and battle through candy-coated chaos to topple the Candy Kingdom. The Sweet Revolution begins—bite back!

card.name: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
card.description: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

card.name: Beam Them All
card.description: An incremental strategy about cosmic hunting: pilot your flying saucer, abduct animals with a tractor beam, and gather biomass to unlock new technologies. Upgrade your ship, expand the field, and evacuate in time before turrets and mines cut your expedition short.

card.name: Yes Chef!
card.description: There's never a calm day in this kitchen! A first-person co-op restaurant game for 1-6 players. Pick burgers, steak, pizza, breakfast or salad, cook, serve and rush to save the burning dish. Can you reach the final day before your customers lose patience? If you fail, everything resets.

card.name: Island Shuffle
card.description: Build little islands, your way. Combine buildings and upgrades, enjoy colorful scenery, and watch your score grow.
